title: Neodustria Phase 20 Autonomous Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery Ledger
scientific_framework: Meta Muse Causal Abductive Induction + Buckingham-Pi Dimensional Analysis

induced_principles.name: Folded Floating Shuttle Kinematic Parasitic Inversion
induced_principles.mathematical_formulation: delta_parasitic_net = |delta_x_outer - delta_x_inner| <= 0.040 mm for L_inner / L_outer = 0.70
induced_principles.hypothesis: Nesting intermediate floating shuttles with folded inner flexures inverts the sign of axial foreshortening, eliminating transverse drift without requiring over-stiff compound guides.
induced_principles.falsification_test: Tested across Task 01, Task 02, Task 05, Task 13 (Task N) and Task 16 (Task O).
induced_principles.empirical_advantage: Enables 100% success on Task 01, Task 02, Task 05, Task 08, Task 09, Task 12, Task 13, Task 16, achieving 5.15 MPa peak stress on Task N vs 8.14 MPa for classical baseline (36.7% stress reduction).

induced_principles.name: Dimensionless Flexural Thickness Invariance
induced_principles.hypothesis: Flexure thickness can be directly mapped in 1 evaluation without iterative search by calibrating architecture-specific dimensionless compliance kappa_arch.
induced_principles.falsification_test: Evaluated against 20 unseen tasks across 3 materials (Polypropylene, Delrin POM, Titanium Ti-6Al-4V).
induced_principles.empirical_advantage: Eliminated the Task M search failure, achieving 55.0% overall feasible yield across the 20-task suite vs 40.0% for classical adaptive search.

induced_principles.name: High-Force Series Folding Compliance Saturation
induced_principles.mathematical_formulation: Abstain from multi-stage folding when Fy > 7.5 N and envelope AR > 1.8
induced_principles.hypothesis: Under high loads (Fy >= 8.0N), folded series flexures experience excessive second-order lateral beam buckling, necessitating bilateral compound parallelogram guidance.
induced_principles.falsification_test: Observed on Task 03 (8.0N) and Task 14 (9.0N) where Neodustria folded priority yielded 0% while classical compound search succeeded.
induced_principles.empirical_advantage: Added to CASM negative causal memory registry as active abstention constraint.
